definition-dropped.flag: character | in a coded character set (newer: undefined); character | in a screen item (newer: undefined); character | in cobol character repertoire (newer: undefined); character | in computer storage (newer: undefined)
definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 splits 'character' into four senses (4.26 a code value of a coded character set, 4.27 a graphic character in a screen item, 4.28 a COBOL character, 4.29 a single code value in storage); 2023 drops those entries but keeps each sense under its own term (§2023:3.7 alphanumeric character, national character, §2023:3.93 graphic character, §2023:3.37 COBOL character repertoire), so the drop is of a heading, not of a meaning. 'One character data item' is one character position of identifier-3's usage (4.29/4.31), display or national, the same unit 2023 uses.

pending-clause.answer: The flag comes from the words 'as literal-1' matching the pattern for the AS literal of a constant entry; GR2 (§2002:14.8.39.3 GR2) concerns a figurative constant in STRING and involves no arithmetic, so §2002:8.8.1.1/8.8.1.3.1/8.8.1.3.6 do not govern it.
